prompt: The query in the editor has one mistake. Fix it so that it answers this question: for the users who signed up from October to December 2025, how many users of each signup cohort paid in each of its first four months? A user's cohort month is the month of signup_ts, in UTC, and a user counts as paying in a month with at least one payment that was not refunded, by the UTC month of paid_at. The month offset counts calendar months from the cohort month, from 0 to 3. The as-of date is 5 January 2026: a month that ends after it is not known yet and shows missing, while a month that has ended with no paying user shows 0. Return three columns, in this order: cohort_month (the first day of the month), month_offset and paying_users. Return one row for each cohort month and each month offset from 0 to 3. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, check the cells whose month has not ended by the as-of date.
A month from January 2026 on has no data yet; it should show missing, and only an ended month with no payer shows 0.
starter_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
sizes AS (  -- one row per cohort month
  SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users
  FROM cohort
  GROUP BY cohort_month
),
paid AS (  -- one row per cohort user and month with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id, c.cohort_month,
         date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE)) AS month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT z.cohort_month, k.month_offset,
       COUNT(pd.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM sizes z
CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
LEFT JOIN paid pd ON pd.cohort_month = z.cohort_month AND pd.month_offset = k.month_offset
GROUP BY z.cohort_month, k.month_offset, z.cohort_users
why_this_works: The CASE leaves a month that starts on or after 1 January 2026 missing, so an unknown month no longer looks like a month in which nobody paid.
